crop_recommendation.dataset_provenance: Historical district/season crop area and production statistics (DESAgri/APY mirror; packaged data 1997-2015)
crop_recommendation.ranking_method: Descending mean recorded cultivated area per observation over the latest five available years in the selected evidence slice; ties broken by observation count and mean recorded production.
crop_recommendation.limitations: This shortlist reflects crops historically cultivated in the selected region and season, not a promise of profitability or farm-specific suitability. The APY data does not include farm-level soil type or soil-test measurements, so those inputs do not change the crop ranking; they are used by separate soil/fertilizer advisory components. The packaged historical series ends in 2015. Validate current choices against the latest district KVK/state agriculture university advisory, irrigation, soil test, variety, pest pressure, and market access. Google search results can differ by query and source; exact result matching cannot be guaranteed.

fertilizer_guidance.method: ICAR Recommended Dose of Fertilizer (RDF) adjusted by Soil Test Crop Response (STCR) + ML Classifier
fertilizer_guidance.nitrogen_double_counting_safeguard: DAP contributed 19.6 kg/ha N, deducted before calculating Urea requirement.
fertilizer_guidance.application_schedule: Full N, P, K at sowing; apply Gypsum @ 400 kg/ha at pegging (35-40 DAS)
safety_warnings: Never mix Urea with lime or alkaline substances directly.
Apply DAP and MOP at the root zone (basal), not as broadcast on wet foliage.
Split Nitrogen doses to minimize volatilization and leaching losses.
fertilizer_guidance.sources: ICAR-IISS Soil Test Crop Response (STCR) & State Agricultural University Package of Practices.

irrigation_guidance.method: Hybrid Decision Tree ML Classifier + FAO-56 Agronomic Water Balance
irrigation_guidance.rainfall_data_nature: Climatological historical normal (IMD 1951-2000), not a live weather forecast
irrigation_guidance.advisory: Light supplemental irrigation recommended (16 mm deficit) during dry spells.
water_conservation_tips: Use organic mulching (crop residue / straw) to reduce surface soil evaporation by up to 30%.
Adopt drip or micro-sprinkler irrigation to achieve 40-50% water savings compared to flood irrigation.
Schedule irrigation during early morning or evening hours to minimize evaporative loss.
Construct farm ponds or check dams for in-situ rainwater harvesting under PMKSY.
irrigation_guidance.sources: FAO-56 Crop Evapotranspiration Guidelines & IMD District Climatological Normals.

documents: Identity/KYC information as required by the official process
Farmer/holding information as required by the local soil-testing process
limitations: Farmer-facing crop shortlist is ranked from historical APY crop-area records (DESAgri). An experimental APY-trained Random Forest crop classifier also executes internally in shadow mode without altering the displayed ranking.
Soil health assessments utilize official ICAR-IISS diagnostic threshold ratings with an internal Random Forest validation layer.
Fertilizer recommendations are calculated via ICAR Soil Test Crop Response (STCR) principles, commercial NPK conversions, and a trained ML classifier.
Irrigation requirements are classified via an interpretable Decision Tree trained on FAO-56 water balance and IMD climatological normal rainfall.
Government scheme matches indicate potential eligibility based on official published criteria; formal approval is subject to competent authorities.
